correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge2\), noncrossing partitions are closed under meet (prove by alternating endpoints). Witnesses with each one edge negative are sufficient by meeting the witnesses for all negatives. Every shattered support is a forest by a cycle obstruction. A noncrossing tree shatters via component partitions; a tree containing crossing chords fails a one-edge-negative labeling after deleting a connecting-path edge. The \(n-1\) upper bound is attained by a convex fan. Opposite diameters give an inclusion-maximal shattered matching via a one-nonsingleton-block realization; all-positive diameters force the one-block partition. The cited 2023 counting theorem supplies the exact known number of noncrossing trees. Independent exact exhaustive checker tests all supports through n=6 and all maximum supports for n=7, and reproduces the claimed diametral configuration properties through n=14. Infinite claims rest on proof, not experiments.

originality.rationale: The first paper treats geometric noncrossing-tree reconfiguration, not shattering by noncrossing equivalence relations; the second establishes the pre-existing noncrossing tree enumeration but no query-response interpretation or nonpure facet theorem. The third treats general primal/dual combinatorial dimensions without this concrete concept class. Accessible research-record results on Catalan hypergraph edge enumeration, matroid basis shattering, and fixed-size bipartitions neither imply the described maximum-support class nor the crossing-matching maximal faces. Search failure is not a uniqueness proof; alternative historical terminology is a residual risk.
residual_risks: Historical literature could use alternate terminology such as noncrossing closure independence, partition teaching sets, or trace complexes; search absence is not priority proof.
The tree-count formula is classical and explicitly not original; only the connection to maximum shattered supports and the linearly nonpure facets is proposed as new.
The two geometric papers were read in full accessible HTML, while the general combinatorial-dimension paper received abstract-level inspection only.

value.rationale: This is a motivated full characterisation of the largest shattered supports of the canonical Catalan partition concept class, with exact enumeration imported from a cited theorem, a universal deletion-witness test for all supports, and a structural unbounded failure of purity. For every even \(n=2m\) the two inclusion-maximal face sizes m and \(2m-1\) differ by \(m-1\); unlike an arbitrary finite table, this exhibits an infinite obstruction to graphic-matroid-type interpretations. No rebranded count or complete lower-face census is claimed.
